verdict.rationale: Temporal's Web UI lets ops view workflow event history/logs (temporal-gh-2, temporal-gh-1), and community evidence confirms a 'reset' feature that resumes a workflow from a specific failed statement rather than starting over (temporal-comm-8), plus built-in automatic retries for failed Activities (temporal-docs-10). However, first-party docs don't detail the reset-from-failure workflow itself, and community reports note real gaps in error visibility (errors buried in event log, stuck 'In Progress' states requiring manual termination) that complicate diagnosing and resuming failed executions (temporal-comm-3, temporal-comm-4). Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the Reset API/CLI command, evidence of granular log inspection UX, and resolution of the community-reported error-visibility gaps.
